sprites.prompt:
Use case: game-assets. Production native RGBA sprite atlas on true transparent background. EXACTLY TWELVE separate isolated metal parts, strict FOUR columns by THREE rows in ordinary reading order. Canvas landscape 4:3 aspect. Each cell holds one object centered with at least 18% completely transparent empty border on all sides, objects never touch adjacent cells. NO labels, NO cell frames, NO text, NO numerals, NO guides, NO backdrop.
All parts match REDLINE industrial instrument materials: layered graphite near-black metal, bright cold satin-silver machined edges, tiny restrained vermilion red light insets, no brass or gold, no rusty grunge. Front orthographic view, clean bold forms, good readability at small sprite sizes.
ROW ONE:
1. A complete narrow vertical pendulum assembly, long thin silver rigid rod extending from a small round TOP pivot down to one heavy dark chamfered oblong bob with one fine vertical red inset. Rod and bob one connected object, straight vertical, no frame.
2. A perfectly circular balance wheel, thin silver ring, SIX silver spokes, tiny centered red bearing, empty transparent sectors between spokes. NO surrounding housing, NO bridge across the face, NO external support, NO text.
3. A single circular precision silver escape gear with clean large triangular teeth and thin graphite inner ring, three metal spokes, red center pin, transparent gaps.
4. One short wide rectangular percussion mallet HEAD ONLY, dark chamfered block with cold silver edges and a fine horizontal red inset, front view, no hanging rod or frame.
ROW TWO:
5. One extremely flat elliptical chrome hi-hat cymbal upper plate, front side view, broad metal shallow cone and tiny red central hub, one plate only, no stand or second plate.
6. One blank tall narrow black mechanical clock card, softly chamfered polygonal corners, thin dark silver edge, small TOP central circular hanging hole and absolutely NO DIGITS or letters.
7. One vertical long narrow silver compression coil spring, continuous helical wire with clear transparent spaces between each turn, no blocks attached.
8. One vertical long narrow metal hanging chain, continuous connected oval silver links, no other pieces.
ROW THREE:
9. One round dark metal wind-chime medallion with a tiny geometric red three-blade center emblem and top hanging ring, outer circle silver.
10. One small hanging bell with dark graphite skirt, cold silver edge, thin red seam at bottom and top hanging ring.
11. One four-pointed angular silver-black star wind-chime ornament, a small red central circle, top hanging ring.
12. One narrow vertical graphite wind-chime tail plate with chamfered corners, fine vertical red inset and small top hanging hole.
Maintain separated coherent sprite silhouettes and transparent gaps. Every object completely uncut. High quality rendered game UI prop sprites with clean anti-aliased alpha, not a blueprint, no shadows outside each silhouette.
